newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba shares boosted by Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Veba shares boosted by Q1 earnings.

text.p: Shares in German utility and telecommunications group Veba AG raced ahead in early pre-bourse trade after its first quarter earnings report surpassed expectations, traders said.
"It looks like Veba will be the stock of the day," said a Frankfurt dealer. "The numbers were significantly above forecasts."
Veba's shares topped turnover volumes in early pre-bourse trade as they rose 2.95 marks, or 3.27 percent to 93.15 marks by 0707 GMT.
The IBIS DAX index, fired by Wall Street's overnight gains, was up 1.1 percent at 3,604.45 points.
Veba had said it expected to be able to raise its profits for 1997 as it continues to take measures to cut costs and improve efficiency.
The company also said its first quarter net profit after minorities rose seven percent to 486 million marks while pre-tax profit rose 6.8 percent to 1.08 billion marks.
